description: Fallback for RBA data the focused tools don't cover (e.g. f6 actual lending rates, f2 bond yields, g1 inflation expectations, d1 credit growth). Call with just `table` to list its series, then again with `series` ids (or a `search` phrase) to get the data.

end.description: Latest period, YYYY-MM. Omit for up to the latest release.

search.description: Words that must all appear in the series title, e.g. 'owner-occupier variable'.

series.description: Series IDs from the table's list, e.g. FILRHLBVS.

start.description: Earliest period, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2022-01). Omit for the full history.

table.description: RBA table id as on rba.gov.au/statistics/tables, e.g. f6, f2, g1, d1.

name: rba_series
title: Any RBA statistical table
